stable.notes: Task rows open. Click one and you get the whole line with its source, lane, section, schedule and agent state, instead of the short title the server trims for the glasses. Edit the words and save them, mark a task Done or Reopen it, send it back to inbox, schedule it, or hand it to COS, all from the same place. A task with a running agent refuses a text edit rather than changing the job underneath it. A new Domains card sets your own domain list instead of hand-editing a profile file, and it says plainly that removing a name only unlists it while the folder and its tasks stay. Needs server 6.44.3.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
